name: [🧲] Collect Coins
desc:
⚡ COLLECT COINS ⚡
Become the ULTIMATE Coin Collector!

Grab your magnet and start your coin empire! Pull massive amounts of coins, unlock legendary pets, and dominate the leaderboards! 💰

🔥 HOW TO PLAY: 
🧲 COLLECT: Use your Magnet to gather Coins around the map! 
💵 UPGRADE: Unlock stronger magnets and boost your collection speed!
⚡ MULTIPLIER MADNESS - Stack boosts to become unstoppable!
🐾 RARE PETS: Find pets around the map which give you multipliers, can you collect them all?
🖥️ AFK: Collect Coins while AFK

👍 LIKE for more updates!⭐ FAVORITE to never miss new content! JOIN the coin collector community!

[Early Access] - Found a bug? Drop feedback and help us make the game even better!
